# v1.0.1 — deterministic release preparation

This patch release keeps the stable v1 CLI unchanged while synchronizing the
root npm wrapper, independent Pi package, and Python project metadata at
`1.0.1`. Release metadata assertions now follow the checked-out root version
and its matching release note.

Validated offline with Python compilation/tests, root npm tests, Pi typecheck and
tests, and root/Pi `npm pack --dry-run` checks. No live provider call, publish,
tag, or GitHub Release creation is part of this preparation.
